scope: Frontend audit proposal; source extraction and acceptance require integrator review. No source code copied.

source.hash_algorithm: SHA-256 of pinned Git blob bytes; git_blob is Git SHA-1 object ID
source.license_status: NOT_ESTABLISHED: no LICENSE/COPYING/NOTICE found in tracked source; package.json is private and has no license field. User authorized audit; this does not establish third-party redistribution rights.

scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && node ../scripts/check-product-copy.mjs --bundle dist && node ../scripts/check-frontend-bundle.mjs

required_adaptations: Use C03-generated paths and same-origin /api; remove localhost:8080 and /v1 assumptions.
Inject in-memory access-token provider and C03 refresh policy; remove X-account context.
Set explicit command retry/idempotency policy; do not inherit ky retry defaults for stock, consent, or pickup.
Do not forward API bearer, cookie, or CSRF headers to a presigned host; validate signed headers against C04 media contract.
Close the abort-after-precheck/before-listener race; settle and clean up on abort/error/load/timeout.
required_probes: 401/409/429 and malformed envelopes
abort before request and during upload; timeout and listener cleanup
presigned PUT has withCredentials=false and no API credentials
failed finalize never reports uploaded; mutation is not blindly retried

extract_only: error envelope parser only after C03 reconciliation
required_adaptations: Separate classification from presentations/presentApiError; do not copy Korean presentation text or commercial/account-specific codes.
Replace strict envelope with frozen C03 error schema and new English UI messages.
Keep unknown codes forward compatible and raw backend detail out of product copy.
required_probes: network vs timeout vs abort vs schema failure
invalid JSON and unknown semantic code
request ID and bounded field errors preserved

extract_only: strict parsing and bounded return-target allowlist concepts
CSRF/origin failure assertions; no old rule table or cookie names
required_adaptations: C03 must map actual selected Gateway operations, token shapes, supported providers and callback/return targets.
Keep one canonical Auth UUID; optional X/Instagram are not identity or entry prerequisites.
Access token in memory, one refresh promise, Secure HttpOnly refresh cookie and agreed origin/CSRF controls.
Remove /v1/auth/email, bigyeting_csrf/admin cookies, member/admin CSRF cache assumptions, X-account versions and 43-character completion-token assumption.
Logout/revoke/deletion clears private queries, drafts and world resources; do not copy session UI store or old router.
required_probes: concurrent 401 => one refresh; refresh failure settles all callers
unavailable provider/denial/expired state is truthful
external/protocol-relative/encoded unsafe return target rejected
logout identity switch rejects late response; token absent from browser storage

extract_only: cancel then remove private roots before identity transition
required_adaptations: Replace activeXAccountId and fallback none with explicit canonical user_id + event_id scopes.
Rebuild roots for MCR; old introLink/accessRequestReveal/blocks roots are not uniformly viewer-scoped.
Use identity/policy generation guards as well as cancellation; never let late results restore a previous identity.
Evict secrets on revoke/block/expiry/suspension and coordinate world subscriptions.
Do not import old API types/client barrel, recommendation/taste/billing query roots or persisted private cache.
required_probes: A delayed response cannot populate B or event B
clear receipts before dependent invalidation
revoke/block expiry removes visible cached handles and stream subscriptions
anonymous state cannot share private scope

extract_only: contactBypass normalization as policy candidate, not universal text ban
strict disclosure/provider URL and safe return-target checks after contract review
required_adaptations: Replace prefixed mem_/sacct_/intro_ identifiers and pinned account fields with canonical contract IDs.
Retain half-open interval and unknown/null semantics but verify bounds 14..100/15..101 against approved C04/BE25 contract; do not set MCR eligibility from source constants.
Split pure functions from Korean error/copy tables and provider-specific draft model; author English messages.
Contact heuristic can reject normal links/9 digits; apply only to consent-protected fields if C04 approves.
Do not port client age claims as authoritative verification; backend owns verified age/privacy.
required_probes: emoji/code-point length; trim/duplicate/limit tags
[min,max) equal/reversed/one-null/both-null and boundary values
no public exact-age/handle fields; disclosure pair invalidation
fullwidth/zero-width contact normalization fixtures and acceptable prose
source test fixtures must be synthetic; do not import UI expectations or backend file reads

extract_only: image MIME/size planning and final-file checks
required_adaptations: Extract MediaProgress to image-only types, removing dependency back into mixed media-preparation.
No media-processors, ffmpeg-compressor or animated-webp-input imports; reject unsupported animation or handle through a separately agreed image-only policy.
Source 6MiB/6 items/4096px/5.75MB target are not new server policy; use C04 approved limits.
Keep preserveExif=false; MIME/extension hints are not server validation.
Do not mark 100 percent preparation as server-finalized upload.
required_probes: abort forwarded to worker and cancellation settles
empty/unsupported/video rejected; final size/type checked
same-origin worker URL bundled, EXIF disabled
malformed WebP rejected if metadata helper retained; no FFmpeg network fetch

extract_only: failed finalize and unattached-upload cleanup patterns only
dependencies_after_adaptation: new HTTP and upload ports; C04 generated types
required_adaptations: Replace socialAccountId, /v1 endpoints, old client barrel and introductory publishing workflow with injected ports.
Release object URLs on removal/unmount/identity change; media-attachment currently creates URLs without owning revocation.
Reconcile uncertain finalize by receipt/status before deleting or retrying; source catch-and-delete is not sufficient proof.
New upload state machine distinguishes prepared/uploaded/finalizing/complete/failed/cancelled and English errors.
Exclude IndexedDB/private draft persistence from write-draft-recovery.ts; scope any future draft state by user/event.
required_probes: finalize error/timeout never displays success
retry reuses command identity and reconciles committed result
blob URLs revoked once and late upload completion ignored after identity change
presigned PUT receives no bearer/cookie/CSRF and abort removes listener

exclusion_policy: Deny all old JSX/CSS/assets/layouts/navigation/themes/snapshots even if absent from this conservative path inventory. An audit candidate is not an import allowlist. Old TSX tests may supply semantic ideas only; no markup/screenshots/selectors copied.

evidence.source_inspection: Pinned tracked blob hashes verified against clean checkout

integration_requirements: Review candidates and consolidate C01 source-map; backend audit remains separate.
Implement C08 allowlist/hash/import gate using reviewed candidate symbols and manual visual review; never approve an entire mixed file from this list.
Pin exact Node 24 patch/digest; parent selected isolated Node 24.22.2 and pnpm 11.7.0, installation not verified here.
Retain exact lock resolutions including TypeScript 6.0.3, Vite 8.1.3 and Oxlint 1.72.0; replace Bigyeting-specific scripts.
Freeze C03/C04/C07 before extracting auth/domain adapters; add regression evidence and ancestry at each extraction.
